Start date: 1357-04-10 (assuming format is DD-MM-YYYY, so 10 April 1357).  
Subtract 48 weeks = 48 × 7 = 336 days.  
Subtract another 4 days → total subtract 340 days.  

1357 is not a leap year (divisible by 100 but not by 400).  
Days from 10 April back to 1 Jan = 31 (Jan) + 28 (Feb) + 31 (Mar) + 9 days in April = 99 days.  
Remaining days to subtract = 340 − 99 = 241 days into previous year (1356).  

1356 is a leap year (divisible by 4 and 400 rule not applicable as year < 1582, but historical leap year rule for Gregorian proleptic: divisible by 4).  
Days in 1356 after subtracting from end: 366 − 241 = 125 days left in 1356.  
125 days from 1 Jan 1356: Jan 31 (31), Feb 29 (60), Mar 31 (91), Apr 30 (121), May 4 (125).  

So date is 1356-05-04.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1356-05-04
